issue_request: FHIR-13205 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO change for STU3. It asked to remove redundant ProcedureRequest extensions; after reopening, the final revote removed authorizedBy as a duplicate of requester and reasonRefused as a duplicate of reasonRejected, while comments clarified that targetBodySite was not redundant with the coded bodySite element.
initial_application: The issue was applied through May-July 2017 #13205 commits against ProcedureRequest extension source: 7c87cdc edited the extension spreadsheet, 308dea0 amended the targetBodySite handling, and 62dd409 fixed the target body extension context to include ProcedureRequest. The later GF#13867 rename/merge moved ProcedureRequest into ServiceRequest.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as active and comments ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest definitions cover requester/authorizer, reason/status rationale, and target body location through requester, reason, statusReason, and bodyStructure. Active core-source and extension-pack searches found none of the obsolete ProcedureRequest extension URLs outside release-history material.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current build source is already consistent with the final FHIR-13205 decision, so an empty no-change audit commit was published.
